Ứng dụng có quảng cáo native được đánh d: The app contains labeled native ads within scrolling content. Google AdMob and map, weather, sign-in, data and music services apply their own terms. Spotube is a separately installed companion app; music discovery and provider sign-in take place in Spotube. MyMap controls playback after you approve a connection in Spotube. You may also listen to radio or import audio files you have the right to use. Paid plans, playback rights and regional restrictions are determined by each provider. MyMap does not grant ownership rights, bypass access restrictions or download protected music.
Chính sách cập nhật ngày 05/10/2026. Nhà: This policy was updated on October 5, 2026. The MyMap developer listed on the distribution store page is responsible for data collected by MyMap. Use the developer contact channel on that page to exercise your data rights. Third-party service providers process data under their own policies linked below.
Hành trình và ảnh cục bộ được lưu tới kh: Local journeys and photos are retained until you delete them or a retention setting removes them. Uninstalling the app or clearing its device data can erase local data. Server account data is retained to maintain your account and selected features until deletion is requested, except where law requires retention. Internet transfers use HTTPS; Spotube control uses a local WebSocket on the same device. Account and access information uses each provider's mechanisms. No system can guarantee absolute security.
Khi bạn chọn tệp âm thanh, MyMap lưu bản: When you select audio files, MyMap saves a copy in its private app storage for offline listening. Original files remain unchanged; removing imported audio deletes only the MyMap copy. The queue, favorites, recent listening and playback settings stay on your device. MyMap does not automatically upload your audio files. Spotube connections use only a local address on the same device and require your approval. MyMap receives track title, artist, artwork, queue and playback state, not provider passwords or sign-in tokens. Radio searches, online streams and artwork requests send your IP and necessary queries to the relevant services. Now-playing sharing is off by default. If you enable it while sharing your location with friends, the track title and artist may accompany your presence status. You can disable sharing, disconnect Spotube or remove imported audio at any time.
Mở Spotube đã cài trên điện thoại để tìm: Open Spotube installed on your phone to find music and connect provider accounts in that app. Once you approve a connection, MyMap can show the current track and control play, pause, track changes, seek, shuffle and repeat. Radio and imported audio share MyMap's player, including a queue, favorites, recent listening, volume and sleep timer. Imported audio can play offline; radio requires Internet. MyMap audio supports lockscreen play/pause controls. The app does not autoplay on launch, and now-playing sharing is off by default. Sleep timers use an absolute deadline but can be delayed if the operating system suspends the app.
Quảng cáo native nằm trong nội dung cuộn: Native ads appear within scrolling content without blocking the map, navigation or SOS. Music uses your selected player. When switching between MyMap and Spotube, MyMap releases or transfers playback control to avoid overlapping audio sources.
